__description_regex_comment__: To disable the regex search & replace of the transaction description, set both to an empty string.
__auto_save_persistence_comment__: When true, the FinTS persistence token is written back into this config file automatically after a successful login/import, so you never have to copy it manually. The importer process must have write access to this file. The token is a secret. Leave false to keep managing bank_fints_persistence by hand.

choose_account_automation.__from_to_comment__: The following values will be passed directly into DateTime. Set them to null to choose them manually during import process.
